item.text: The targets are set using the amm PA12 material model. The search is comparing all supported cell families with pessimistic performance estimates to account for the fast solver’s known bias.

The first search found no design meeting all three targets. Its best candidate exceeded the solid-fraction limit, fell below the stiffness minimum, and had a gap starting above 20.5 kHz. I’m checking a second search objective before concluding.

arguments.note: Two atlas-seeded searches, each with 96 evaluations, using pessimistic and expected objectives across the supported TPMS, strut and resonator family pool found no design meeting the unchanged PA12, 12 mm, density <=0.23, E100 >=168 MPa and complete 20.5–30.7 kHz gap targets. The best pessimistic candidate (cube_bars c=0.61414, w=0.20967) has search-tier solid fraction 0.282807, E100=131.902 MPa and a main complete gap 27.032–52.575 kHz, failing density, stiffness and coverage of the lower target frequencies. No design is released. This bounded search result is not proof of infeasibility.
